title: Cleft sentences (It is… / What… is…)
contains: It is/was \[X\] that/who…, What \[X\] does is…, The thing that… is…, All I need is…, акцент на разных членах предложения.
intro:
✨ Тема: Cleft sentences (It is… / What… is…) — эмфатические конструкции, которые выделяют главное.

⏱ Сколько займет: 5-7 дней по 30 минут

🎯 После этой темы ты сможешь: выделять любой член предложения через It is… that… и What… is…; делать речь акцентированной и выразительной.

sections.title: 🎯 Зачем эта тема
sections.html:
Cleft («расщепленные») предложения — способ выделить одну часть мысли. Вместо ровного «Anna broke the vase» ты говоришь «It was Anna who broke the vase» (именно Анна) или «What Anna did was break the vase». Это расставляет акценты и звучит выразительно.

Когда это нужно:

  • Выделить кто/что: It was her confidence that impressed everyone.
  • Выделить действие: What I need is a holiday.
  • Пояснить: The thing that bothers me is the noise.

Главное правило: берем обычное предложение и «расщепляем» его на две части, чтобы подсветить одну.

Связь с другими темами C1: родственна инверсии (тема 7) и субстантивации (тема 10) — все это способы управлять акцентом.

sections.title: 📖 Теория
sections.html:
1. It-cleft: It is/was [X] that/who…

Выделяем любой член предложения, ставя его после It is/was:

ОбычноеCleft (акцент)
Anna broke it.It was Anna who broke it.
I want freedom.It is freedom that I want.
We met in Rome.It was in Rome that we met.
She called yesterday.It was yesterday that she called.

Люди → who/that, вещи/время/место → that.

2. Wh-cleft (What… is…)

Начинаем с What, акцент — в конце после is:

  • What I need is a break.
  • What impressed me was her honesty.
  • What he did was (to) ignore the warning.

3. The thing/place/reason that… is…

Разновидность wh-cleft:

  • The thing (that) I love is the silence.
  • The reason (why) I came is to help.
  • The place where it happened was the office.

4. All (that)… is… (только)

Со значением «все, что / единственное»:

  • All I want is some peace.
  • All she did was (to) smile.

5. Акцент на действии: What… do is…

  • What you should do is (to) call them.
  • What we did was (to) wait. (после do — часто голый инфинитив)

6. Начало с It / There для акцента

  • It's not that I dislike it; it's that I'm tired.
💡 Cleft часто отвечает на скрытый вопрос: «Who broke it?» → It was Anna who…»

pages.title: 1. It-cleft: It is/was [X] that/who…
pages.html:
Выделяем любой член предложения, ставя его после It is/was:

ОбычноеCleft (акцент)
Anna broke it.It was Anna who broke it.
I want freedom.It is freedom that I want.
We met in Rome.It was in Rome that we met.
She called yesterday.It was yesterday that she called.

Люди → who/that, вещи/время/место → that.

pages.title: 2. Wh-cleft (What… is…)
pages.html:
Начинаем с What, акцент — в конце после is:

  • What I need is a break.
  • What impressed me was her honesty.
  • What he did was (to) ignore the warning.

pages.title: 3. The thing/place/reason that… is…
pages.html:
Разновидность wh-cleft:

  • The thing (that) I love is the silence.
  • The reason (why) I came is to help.
  • The place where it happened was the office.

pages.title: 4. All (that)… is… (только)
pages.html:
Со значением «все, что / единственное»:

  • All I want is some peace.
  • All she did was (to) smile.

pages.title: 5. Акцент на действии: What… do is…
pages.html:
• What you should do is (to) call them.
  • What we did was (to) wait. (после do — часто голый инфинитив)

pages.title: 6. Начало с It / There для акцента
pages.html:
• It's not that I dislike it; it's that I'm tired.
💡 Cleft часто отвечает на скрытый вопрос: «Who broke it?» → It was Anna who…»

sections.title: 🎙 Как это видит носитель / Где палится русскоязычный
sections.html:
👁 Как это видит носитель

  • Cleft — это интонация, перенесенная в грамматику. В устной речи носитель часто просто делает ударение: ANNA broke it. На письме голоса нет — и тут помогает It was Anna who broke it.
  • Wh-cleft — готовая «рамка» для вступления. What I'd like to talk about is…, What happened was…, What I mean is… — носитель так анонсирует следующую мысль в презентации, рассказе или споре и выигрывает секунду на обдумывание.
  • Обратный cleft — самая разговорная форма. That's what I mean. / This is where it gets interesting. / That's why I left. — указательное местоимение впереди, wh-часть в конце. В бытовой речи звучит чаще, чем классический It-cleft.
  • It's not that…, it's (just) that… — инструмент мягкого несогласия. It's not that I don't like the idea, it's just that we don't have the budget. Носитель сначала снимает неверную трактовку, потом называет настоящую причину.
  • It was only when / not until… that… — момент озарения. It was only when I moved abroad that I understood my parents. В нарративе и эссе эта форма подсвечивает поворотную точку — мягкая альтернатива инверсии Only when… did I….

⚠️ Где палится русскоязычный

Калька (как думаем по-русски)ОшибкаКак надо
«Именно поэтому я ушел»Exactly therefore I left.That's (exactly) why I left.
«Это он мне сказал» (именно он)This is he told me.It was him who told me. / He's the one who told me.
«Вот тут начинается самое интересное»Here starts the most interesting.This is where it gets interesting.
«Что мне нужно, так это время»What I need, so it is time.What I need is time.
«Дело не в том, что я не хочу»The matter is not in that I don't want.It's not that I don't want to.
«То, что он сказал, меня удивило»That he said surprised me.What he said surprised me.
«Именно тогда я и понял»Exactly then I understood.It was then that I understood.
💡 Самая частая ловушка — переводить «именно» словом exactly: в английском акцент ставит не наречие, а конструкция: It was… that, That's why…, This is where…

sections.title: 🗣 Нарративные приемы носителей / Ошибки именно русскоязычных
sections.html:
🎬 Как носитель чувствует cleft

  • Cleft — способ поставить луч прожектора на одну часть. Для носителя It was Anna who broke it = «именно Анна, а не кто-то еще». Расщепление создает контраст с невысказанной альтернативой.
  • It-cleft выделяет кто/что/когда/где, Wh-cleft — действие или «вещь». Для носителя It was in Rome that… (место) и What I need is… (суть) — два разных инструмента акцента.
  • Cleft отвечает на скрытый вопрос. Для носителя What matters is the result как будто отвечает на «what matters?» — это естественный ход в споре или пояснении.
  • All… is… = «все, что / единственное». Для носителя All I want is peace несет оттенок «только», а не просто «все».
  • После What… did was часто голый инфинитив. Для носителя What he did was ignore it (чаще без to) — естественная форма.

⚠️ Ошибки именно русскоязычных

  • Согласование в wh-cleft. What I need are answers → What I need is answers (What — ед. число).
  • which вместо that/who. It was Anna which called → It was Anna who called.
  • Двойное подлежащее. What I want it is freedom → What I want is freedom.
  • Неверное время It is/was. It is Anna who broke it yesterday → It was Anna….
  • All what. All what I want is peace → All I want is peace (без what).
  • to + V2 после was. What he did was to ignored it → was (to) ignore it.
💡 Общий принцип C1: cleft «расщепляет» предложение, чтобы подсветить одну часть. It is/was [X] that/who… — кто/что/когда/где. What… is… — действие/суть. What — ед. число (is). Люди — who/that, не which.

sections.title: 💡 Примеры с разбором
sections.html:
It-cleft

  • It was her confidence that impressed everyone. (акцент на confidence)
  • It was not until Friday that we heard back. (акцент на время)

Wh-cleft

  • What I find most interesting is how people react under pressure.
  • What we need is a clear plan.

Комбинация

  • All I'm asking for is a little patience. What matters now is the result.

sections.title: ⚠️ Подводные камни
sections.html:
Ошибка 1. Согласование глагола в wh-cleft

❌ What I need are a holiday.

✅ What I need is a holiday. (What — ед. число)

Ошибка 2. which вместо that/who

❌ It was Anna which called.

✅ It was Anna who/that called.

Ошибка 3. Двойное подлежащее

❌ What I want it is freedom.

✅ What I want is freedom.

Ошибка 4. Неверное время It was/is

❌ It is Anna who broke it yesterday. (прошлое)

✅ It was Anna who broke it yesterday.

Ошибка 5. to после What… did was

❌ What he did was to ignored it.

✅ What he did was (to) ignore it. (инфинитив, чаще без to)

exercises.title: Выдели разные члены
exercises.html:
Предложение: Anna met Tom in Paris last year. Выдели через It-cleft:

  1. (кто) ____
  2. (где) ____
  3. (когда) ____
  4. (кого) ____

Предложение: My sister sent the parcel to London on Monday.

  1. (кто) ____
  2. (что) ____
  3. (куда) ____
  4. (когда) ____

Предложение: The storm damaged the roof during the night.

  1. (что именно повредило) ____
  2. (что повредили) ____
  3. (когда) ____

Предложение: We finally signed the contract in Berlin after months of talks.

  1. (что подписали) ____
  2. (где) ____
  3. (когда) ____
  4. А теперь выдели само ДЕЙСТВИЕ — через Wh-cleft: ____
exercises.answers:
1. It was Anna who met Tom in Paris last year.
  2. It was in Paris that Anna met Tom last year.
  3. It was last year that Anna met Tom in Paris.
  4. It was Tom (who/that) Anna met in Paris last year.
  5. It was my sister who sent the parcel to London on Monday.
  6. It was the parcel that my sister sent to London on Monday.
  7. It was to London that my sister sent the parcel on Monday.
  8. It was on Monday that my sister sent the parcel to London.
  9. It was the storm that damaged the roof during the night.
  10. It was the roof that the storm damaged during the night.
  11. It was during the night that the storm damaged the roof.
  12. It was the contract that we finally signed in Berlin.
  13. It was in Berlin that we finally signed the contract.
  14. It was after months of talks that we finally signed the contract.
  15. What we finally did was sign the contract in Berlin. (It-cleft действие не выделяет — для этого нужен Wh-cleft)

  2. Что меня раздражает, так это шум. → The thing ____.
  3. Причина, по которой я пришел, — помочь. → The reason ____.
  4. Место, где мы познакомились, — маленькое кафе. → The place ____.
  5. Все, что он сделал, — извинился. → All ____.
  6. Что меня удивляет, так это ее спокойствие. → The thing ____.
  7. Причина, по которой она ушла, — плохая атмосфера. → The reason ____.
  8. Единственное, о чем я прошу, — честность. → All ____.
  9. День, когда все изменилось, — вторник. → The day ____.

  11. Все, что мы можем, — ждать. → All ____.
  12. Причина, по которой я молчал, — страх. → The reason ____.
  13. Способ, которым он это сказал, и ранил. → The way ____.
  14. Все, чего она хотела, — шанс. → All ____.
  15. Человек, который меня научил, — мой дед. → The person ____.
exercises.answers:
1. All I want is a rest.
  2. The thing that annoys me is the noise.
  3. The reason (why) I came is to help.
  4. The place where we met was a small cafe.

  8. All I'm asking for is honesty.
  9. The day when everything changed was a Tuesday.
  10. The thing (that) I like here is the silence.
  11. All we can do is wait.

  13. The way (that) he said it was what hurt.
  14. All she wanted was a chance.
  15. The person who taught me was my grandfather.

exercises.title: Исправь ошибки
exercises.html:
1. What I need are answers.
  2. It was Anna which called.
  3. What I want it is freedom.
  4. It is Tom who broke it yesterday.
  5. All she did was to smiled.
  6. All what I want is peace.
  7. What I really needs is time.
  8. It was the noise who woke me.
  9. The reason what I left is clear.
  10. What impressed me were her honesty.
  11. It was in Rome where we signed it. (формально)
  12. What he did was ignored the warning.
  13. It were my parents who supported me.
  14. The thing what bothers me is the cost.
  15. All we can do is to waiting.
exercises.answers:
1. ❌ → ✅ What I need is answers.
  2. ❌ → ✅ It was Anna who called.
  3. ❌ → ✅ What I want is freedom.
  4. ❌ → ✅ It was Tom who broke it yesterday.
  5. ❌ → ✅ All she did was (to) smile.
  6. ❌ → ✅ All I want is peace. (без what)
  7. ❌ → ✅ What I really need is time. (без -s)
  8. ❌ → ✅ It was the noise that woke me. (who — только о людях)
  9. ❌ → ✅ The reason (why) I left is clear.
  10. ❌ → ✅ What impressed me was her honesty. (What — ед. число)
  11. ❌ → ✅ It was in Rome that we signed it.
  12. ❌ → ✅ What he did was (to) ignore the warning.
  13. ❌ → ✅ It was my parents who supported me. (It всегда в ед. числе)
  14. ❌ → ✅ The thing that bothers me is the cost.
  15. ❌ → ✅ All we can do is wait.

exercises.title: Ответь с cleft
exercises.html:
Ответь на вопрос, выделяя ответ:

  1. Who paid? (I) → ____
  2. What do you want? (peace) → ____
  3. When did it happen? (yesterday) → ____
  4. Where did you meet? (in Lisbon) → ____
  5. What did he do? (resign) → ____
  6. Why did you call? (to apologise) → ____
  7. Who broke the window? (the neighbour's son) → ____
  8. What annoys you most? (the noise) → ____

exercises.title: Найди ВСЕ ошибки в тексте
exercises.html:
«What I really needs is time. It was my colleague which solved the problem. All what I want is honesty. It is yesterday that the decision was made. What he did was to ignored the warning. What impressed the clients were our speed. It were the interns who noticed the bug. What I want it is a clear answer. The reason what the project failed is obvious. It was the printer who broke down again. The thing what worries me is the budget. All we can do is to waiting. It was in Berlin where we signed the deal. What she did was called the director. It is Max who called me last night.»

(найди 15 ошибок)
exercises.answers:
Исправленный текст:

«What I really need is time. It was my colleague who solved the problem. All I want is honesty. It was yesterday that the decision was made. What he did was (to) ignore the warning. What impressed the clients was our speed. It was the interns who noticed the bug. What I want is a clear answer. The reason (why) the project failed is obvious. It was the printer that broke down again. The thing that worries me is the budget. All we can do is wait. It was in Berlin that we signed the deal. What she did was (to) call the director. It was Max who called me last night.»

Ошибки (15):

  1. ❌ What I really needs → ✅ What I really need (What — ед. число, без -s)
  2. ❌ colleague which → ✅ colleague who (о людях — who/that)
  3. ❌ All what I want → ✅ All I want (без what)
  4. ❌ It is yesterday … was made → ✅ It was yesterday (прошлое)
  5. ❌ was to ignored → ✅ was (to) ignore (инфинитив, не V2)
  6. ❌ What impressed the clients were → ✅ What impressed the clients was (What — ед. число)
  7. ❌ It were the interns → ✅ It was the interns (It всегда в ед. числе)
  8. ❌ What I want it is → ✅ What I want is (без двойного подлежащего)
  9. ❌ The reason what → ✅ The reason (why) (после reason — why или ничего)
  10. ❌ the printer who → ✅ the printer that (who — только о людях)
  11. ❌ The thing what → ✅ The thing that (после thing — that)
  12. ❌ is to waiting → ✅ is wait (голый инфинитив)
  13. ❌ in Berlin where → ✅ in Berlin that (в формальном It-cleft — that)
  14. ❌ was called the director → ✅ was (to) call the director (инфинитив, не V2)
  15. ❌ It is Max who called me last night → ✅ It was Max (last night — прошлое)
